title: Visual Marketing Specialist
description:
Overview

Empowering the Next Generation to End Factory Farming: What would it mean to you if you could dedicate your time, talent, and energy to creating a more just and sustainable food system?

Working at New Roots Institute isn't a job for us; it's a commitment to a cause. We are a growing nonprofit dedicated to ending factory farming, and we are seeking a passionate and experienced Visual Marketing Specialist to join our team!

Is New Roots Institute the right place for you? Here's what you should know:

  • We value having the opportunity to make a difference and aren't afraid of working hard. We're looking for people who possess the resilience and determination to excel in fast-paced and demanding roles while understanding how to differentiate between working really hard (good) and unsustainable self-sacrifice (not so good).
  • We continuously question our own biases and assumptions and adapt when we recognize we're wrong. We're looking for people who are self-aware and know how to put their ego aside to achieve shared goals.
  • We're results-oriented, strive for excellence, and are looking for people who can say they never miss deadlines.
  • Giving and receiving honest and direct feedback is foundational to our culture. We're looking for people who are eager to use constructive feedback to grow, and help others to grow, both personally and professionally.
  • Because we work remotely, proactive communication and quick responses are key to building trust and working effectively together. We're looking for people who excel at keeping everyone updated.
  • We genuinely enjoy working together and look for ways to have fun, despite the tragic nature of what we are up against. Check out our Rotten Truth series on YouTube to see how we use humor to grapple with the grim reality of factory farming.

Responsibilities

  • Create compelling graphic designs, infographics, and multimedia content that advances organizational objectives.
  • Maintain adherence to visual brand guidelines across all organizational materials while developing streamlined processes and templates that enhance our professional reputation.
  • Develop marketing and explainer videos that achieve strong viewership, completion rates, and engagement metrics while meeting production timelines and budgets.
  • Create emotionally resonant visual content that clarifies complex topics and clearly demonstrates organizational impact to diverse external audiences.
  • Collaborate closely with Storytelling and Digital Marketing Specialists to develop cohesive campaigns.
  • Maintain an organized, searchable digital asset library that promotes efficiency and brand consistency across the organization.
  • Proactively contribute creative ideas for visual storytelling and digital optimization during campaign planning phases, going beyond execution to strategic thinking.

Qualifications

  • Able to translate complex organizational impact into clear, engaging visual content that resonates with diverse external audiences and drives measurable engagement results.
  • Committed to maintaining exceptional visual consistency across all touchpoints while ensuring error-free, professional-quality deliverables that enhance organizational reputation.
  • Skilled in video production, photography, and digital design with the ability to manage projects within timelines and budgets while achieving performance targets.
  • Excellent at working cross-functionally with storytelling and digital marketing teams, actively contributing strategic ideas during planning phases rather than simply executing requests.
  • Capable of building and maintaining efficient asset management systems that promote accessibility, reduce redundancy, and streamline workflows across the organization.
  • Focused on achieving measurable outcomes like increased click-through rates, video completion rates, and positive stakeholder feedback while continuously optimizing visual strategies for maximum impact.

Other requirements

  • At least 4 years of equivalent experience in visual marketing and/or communications.
  • Shared vegan and anti-speciesist values. No one on our team consumes animals or animal products or believes that non-human animals can ethically be treated as resources for human use.
  • Ability to commit to attending the annual in-person team meeting, which typically takes place during the last full week of August (Monday through Friday), but may shift to the first week of June.

Compensation and benefits

This is a full-time, remote position with a salary of $62,400 per year, plus a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance, and unlimited PTO.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, especially those who identify as Black, Indigenous, LGBTQIA+, people with disabilities, and people from the global majority. Please note that we are only considering applicants based in the United States at this time.

By submitting your information, you are indicating that you have read our Privacy Policy and accept its terms.

To apply

Please click the "Apply for this position" link to tell us why you are interested in New Roots Institute and to submit your resume. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We hope to fill this position as soon as possible.

The SIS Senior Associate Product Manager will work closely with the engineering and development team to guide the development of our next generation Alarm Monitoring Product. Primary Responsibilities. This position will:

  • Prioritize features, manage the product backlog, and create roadmaps to guide development.
  • Oversee product launch, project planning and implementation, monitoring performance, gathering feedback, and iterating on the product.

Job Duties:

  • Collaborate closely with engineering teams to scope, prioritize, and ship high-impact modernization features
  • Use human centered design principles to uncover user pain points and shape a forward looking product vision
  • Engage regularly with users to gather feedback and translate insights into actionable improvements
  • Define clear product requirements and user stories to support agile planning and execution
  • Lead journey mapping and design workshops to reimagine legacy workflows with modern best practices
  • Prototype and test new features while applying strategic thinking and technical fluency
  • Deliver phased updates (POCs, MVPs, and full releases) with a focus on agility and scalability
  • Align cross-functional stakeholders including marketing and sales on market strategy
  • Translate complex technical concepts into accessible language for diverse teams
  • Leverage user and business insights to drive impactful modernization decisions
  • Document and share tools, processes, and insights to inform future product growth

Key Skills:

  • Technical Proficiency:Understanding technical concepts and working with development teams.
  • Business Acumen:Understanding market trends, business strategy, and financial aspects.
  • Analytical Skills:Analyzing data, identifying trends, and making data-driven decisions.
  • Communication and Collaboration:Effectively communicating with diverse teams and stakeholders.
  • Leadership and Problem-Solving:Leading teams, making decisions, and solving complex problems.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 3–5 years of experience in software engineering or product management, with a foundation in full-stack development and REST API design
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as C#, SQL, and Python, and frameworks like Angular
  • Prior exposure to internal enterprise platforms and a willingness to understand the challenges in modernizing mature systems
  • Proven ability to work cross functionally and translate between technical and nontechnical stakeholders
  • Experience defining user stories, managing roadmaps, and prioritizing for business impact
  • Passion for building intuitive, scalable, and reliable tools for users
  • Strong problem solving skills and a proactive, iterative approach to delivery
  • Leadership experience including launching and running programs
  • A growth mindset and curiosity about modernizing established platforms in a fast moving organization

Special Requirements:

  • US Citizen, with SECRET clearance or ability/desire to obtain a SECRET clearance.
  • Working knowledge of SaaS applications operating in a public cloud infrastructure including Google, AWS, Azure.
  • Previous experience working at a medium to large company engaging division-to-division personnel and central teams.

Desired Requirements:

  • Project planning certification (or a desire to attain such)
  • Agile Training (or a desire to attain such)

Only qualified applicants should apply. Must have U.S. employment authorization.

Travel Requirements: Domestic travel is required up to 1 time per month and up to 3 days per trip. This is a fully remote position. Worksites are unanticipated. Work from home benefit available.

EverCommerce considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, candidate’s work location, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, external market data, as well as, market and business considerations when making compensation decisions.

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.

  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.

Requirements

Accountabilities

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Large OEM or Independent Hardware Vendor (IHV) brands - Dell, HPE, IBM, Lenovo, Ericsson, Cisco, Fujitsu and many more - are major partners for Canonical. Canonical's flagship product, Ubuntu, and its broader open source portfolio are key ingredients for these partners to realize their aspirations. Canonical represents the best platform for rapid open source innovation.
Reporting to the Senior Director of Global Alliances - Dell, the Partner Sales Manager will work closely with Dell and Canonical teams in various geographies to enable Dell teams, generate and transact opportunities, drive a Canonical agenda within Dell, and achieve targeted results. They are responsible to build trusted relationships with Dell, increase Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelize the partnership and drive business interactions from across persona - from engineer to CxO. They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and participate in executive engagements as coordinated by the Senior Director.

  • Grow Dell's awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu

  • Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

A Valsoft Corporation está procurando um especialista em recursos humanos experiente para se juntar à nossa crescente equipe global de RH no Brasil!

Fundada no Canadá em 2015, a Valsoft cresceu e hoje possui um portfólio global de mais de 120 empresas, adquirindo e desenvolvendo empresas de software de mercado vertical, permitindo que cada negócio ofereça as melhores soluções essenciais para os clientes em seus respectivos setores. title: Design Thinker
description:
Overview

Ser MJVer é estar em um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar.

Nós sabemos que na construção de uma sociedade mais forte a evolução deve vir de dentro para fora . Por isso, um ambiente acolhedor e com o sentimento constante de pertencimento é fundamental para o crescimento individual e coletivo.

O esforço é de todos nós, e as conquistas também. Porque ser um MJVer é bem mais do que ser um colaborador: é sobre fazer parte.

Somos colaborativos, ágeis, plurais, criativos e inovadores. Somos MJV!

Responsabilidades e Atividades Principais

Entendimento do Ecossistema: Realizar pesquisas e análises para compreender o ambiente atual, os desafios da implementação do SAP Ariba e as expectativas do cliente em relação à governança e à gestão de mudanças;

Mapeamento e Diagnóstico: Conduzir um diagnóstico detalhado, mapeando os stakeholders e analisando a cultura organizacional para identificar os principais impactos da nova ferramenta nos processos e nas pessoas;

Co-criação de Soluções: Atuar na concepção e prototipação de soluções de gestão de mudanças, como planos de comunicação e engajamento, materiais digitais e workshops, sempre com foco na jornada do usuário;

Empatia e Engajamento: Ajudar a colocar as pessoas no centro do processo, compreendendo seus hábitos, emoções e motivações para mitigar resistências e fomentar uma adoção massiva da nova cultura corporativa;

Atuação e Execução: Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de Gestão de Mudanças e Governança na implementação das estratégias e planos desenvolvidos.

Experiência com Design Thinking: Forte habilidade em aplicar os princípios do Design Thinking, incluindo empatia, pesquisa, ideação e prototipação;

Mentalidade Humanista: Capacidade de ir além de ferramentas e processos, atuando em ações que comuniquem o propósito da transformação e mudem a mentalidade e os valores das pessoas;

Colaboração e Comunicação: Experiência em co-criação com líderes e colaboradores, e na colaboração para engajamento e prontidão para a mudança;

Visão de Projeto: Capacidade de atuar em todas as etapas de um projeto, desde a pesquisa e estratégia até a ideação, teste e validação.

Vale Refeição;

Plano de saúde e odontológico - Amil;

️ Grupos de idiomas;

People Mobility: damos uma forcinha para pessoas que tem interesse e disponibilidade de atuar em projetos desafiadores em outros estados e países;

Ações de treinamento: palestras, fóruns, trocas e conversas de conhecimentos relativos ao nosso negócio. Estamos em constante conexão para aprender mais e juntos;

Parcerias: quer desconto? Temos um grupo no Workplace onde divulgamos parcerias com instituições de ensino, escolas de idiomas, academias, restaurantes, produtos e outros serviços;

Programa +MJVer: programa interno de indicação onde você indica um colega para trabalhar conosco e se esse relacionamento der match, você ganha um prêmio;

Co-criação: conectamos talentos para gerar soluções completas. Colaboração está no nosso sangue.

  • Step 7: Dados pré-admissionais ️ 7 Dados pré-admissionais ️

Sobre a MJV

A MJV é mais do que uma simples consultoria de tecnologia e inovação . Somos um grupo de mentes diversas, visionárias e determinadas, combinando design, dados e uma mentalidade ágil para oferecer soluções completas, que vão desde a concepção até a implementação de TI.

Nosso legado começou há mais de 25 anos , com o propósito de ajudar empresas a prosperar em suas jornadas de transformação. A MJV é composta por um vasto grupo de pessoas que acreditam no trabalho colaborativo. Aplicamos o Design Thinking , as Metodologias Ágeis e a Sustentabilidade em todos os nossos projetos. title: Consultant, Global Pricing & Access (Remote)
description:
Overview

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are EVERSANA.

Team and role context

THE TEAM: Our Global Pricing & Market Access (PMA) team at Navlin is a dynamic, international group that combines deep inhouse expertise with real-time intelligence—from pricing and HTA updates to regulatory news—via Navlin’s industry-benchmark platform. Empowered by advanced price-management software and launch-sequence simulation tools (navlin.com), we deliver strategic, well-informed recommendations on pricing and access for our clients.

Composed of top talent from across Europe, our multicultural team blends local market nuance with creative synergy. We embrace a flexible remote-working model—fully supported by robust IT tools—and maintain satellite offices in London, Berlin, and Milan, freely accessible to all team members. Our team is rapidly expanding with consistent year-on-year growth.

Our project portfolio includes critical initiatives such as, among others, launch sequencing and pricing strategies for ATMPs and orphan drugs, indication-expansion planning, LOE strategy, forecasting, and asset due diligence—spanning Europe and global markets. While a dedicated team oversees U.S. initiatives, we lead global efforts across Europe, APAC, and LATAM. We also collaborate closely with EVERSANA’s internal functions—commercial, HEOR, medical affairs, and others—in global launch execution projects, ensuring PMA remains central to global launch execution of new assets.

The Position

The Consultant, Global Pricing and Market Access position will be involved in delivering client consultancy projects and helping to manage project-related analytics, data and tools available through our industry platform Navlin or dedicated secondary and primary research. The Consultant will ensure that tasks within client projects or internal activities are delivered to schedule, while maintaining the highest level of quality and value expectations.

The Consultant will lead research and analysis focused around: pricing, market access launch strategy, competitor research, value-based pricing analyses, HTA, etc. The Consultant will be involved in identifying client needs and problems and implementing robust strategic and data driven solutions, while managing own workload to prepare the client deliverables. In addition, the Consultant will also contribute to business development through the development of proposals. Activities will be executed under the guidance of an Engagement Manager, mainly remotely due to remote team composition. In some cities with physical EVERSANA offices, the Consultant is fully able to use the company office, as well.

The role is home office based, (full-time position), located in Italy, Remote.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Our consultants are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of the project team. These results are achieved by:

title: Strategic Communications & Change Management Specialist
description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Strategic Communications & Change Management Specialist to support a governance, risk, and compliance transformation at a national agency. The Specialist will be an integral part of an LMI team tasked with building a modernized, risk-informed compliance framework. You will be responsible for planning, supporting, and executing a communications plan, including the development of templates, briefing materials, notes, and other documents. The Specialist will support the entire team, providing best-practice consultation and review for communications artifacts. The Communications Specialists will ensure strong project management through consistent, integrated, and continuous review of materials and products as they are in development.

The Specialist will help develop a comprehensive integration plan that includes timelines, resource allocation, and key milestones - focusing on the change adoption process across field units. Additionally, you will organize and facilitate training sessions for staff to ensure they are well-equipped for the new framework, to include possible new technologies, addressing any concerns or resistance they may have. Throughout the integration process, the Specialist will engage in continuous communication with all stakeholders, providing updates, gathering feedback, and making necessary adjustments. The Specialist will help develop support materials, such as user guides and FAQs to assist employees in the transition.

LMI is a consultancy dedicated to improving the business of government, drawing from commercially successful practices and our deep expertise in advanced analytics, digital services, logistics, and management advisory services. LMI was established in 1961 to enhance operations by incorporating methodologies and innovations from outside the federal government. We cultivate a culture of empowerment, inclusion, diversity, and entrepreneurship. Our employees are encouraged to incorporate new and novel approaches in unconventional spaces to advance our clients goals. We believe our clients can change lives and make a meaningful difference in our Nation, and we seek talented, curious, hardworking people who share that conviction. Our generous compensation package includes excellent benefits that start on the first day of employment. Business casual dress, flex time, and tuition reimbursement are a few of our many work-life benefits available to our employees.

Responsibilities

  • Provide project management, change management, and communications support to the program.
  • Develop, initiate, and maintain leadership communication strategy, messaging, and dissemination plans, including communications plans and community outreach and external collaboration plans aligned with the program.
  • Design and execute comprehensive stakeholder engagement strategy including interview protocols, survey design, and workshop facilitation
  • Establish, implement, and manage change management plans and procedures, to include adoption strategies, readiness assessments, and feedback mechanisms for continuous improvement
  • Support organization-wide rollout through user engagement and adoption facilitation
  • Create and distribute support materials such as user guides, FAQs, and training manuals to aid employees during the transition.
  • Engage in continuous communication with stakeholders to provide updates, gather feedback, and make necessary adjustments throughout the integration process.
  • Enable project leadership to provide the highest-quality findings, briefs, and messaging to agency leadership, to ensure rapid resolution on key issues, effective decision-making on critical opportunities, and accurate capture of historic information.
  • Produce and edit communications, including but not limited to, email messages, talking points, PowerPoint briefing, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Organize and support facilitation of training sessions for staff to ensure proficiency in transformed compliance framework, addressing any questions or concerns.
  • Support team with various consulting tasks, such as task tracking, note-taking, communications and other tasks, as determined necessary by the task lead or Program Manager.
  • Demonstrate commitment to transparency and deliver content that increases engagement.
  • Capture effort risks and issues for effective escalation and resolution.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements :

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in business, communications, or related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in strategic communications and change management in federal agencies or large organizations.
  • Must be able to obtain a Position of Public Trust Clearance (includes fingerprinting, background check, and drug screening).
  • Expertise in writing, briefing, and other forms of communications in a highly sensitive environment.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft tools and programs, including Excel, Office 365/SharePoint, and Teams.
  • Knowledge of developing and executing communications plans.
  • Strong facilitation, analytic, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and iterate products with a variety of internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to work with a team of professionals in a remote environment on expedited timelines.
  • Ability to be comfortable working in ambiguous situations and with unclear direction.

Desired Skills

  • Master's degree or higher in a related discipline
  • 3+ years consulting experience
  • Prosci, ADKAR, or CCMP certification.
  • Experience with large-scale organizational transformation and technology adoption.
  • Agile, Scrum, and/or Lean Six Sigma training.
